title: No Oil Crispy Scallion Chicken
method: Marinate chicken as mentioned and set aside till you need to use it ( you can marinate for a minimum of 30 minutes upto overnight )

caption:
No Oil Crispy Scallion Chicken 
high protein | low fat | 30 minute recipe  | no oil recipe | airfryer 

Nutrition: 
C: 20 | F: 6 | P: 49
Calories: 339 per serve
Serves 2 - 3 

450 grams chicken breasts 
1 tsp soy sauce
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 inch ginger, grated 
1 sachet red chilli flakes 
salt + pepper
1/4 cup rice flour

spring onion coating 
1 tbsp soy sauce + 1 tbsp water 
1 tbsp oyster sauce
1/4 tsp monkfruit or sugar 
4 greens of spring onions, chopped
1 tbsp minced garlic ( 5-6 cloves ) 
1/2 tbsp minced ginger
4 birds eye chilli, finely chopped  OR green chilli works good to add spice - 1-2 is enough 
1/2 tbsp mixed with 2 tbsp water 

Method: 
Marinate chicken as mentioned and set aside till you need to use it ( you can marinate for a minimum of 30 minutes upto overnight ) 
Coat with rice flour well and airfry ( you want to preheat the airfryer for around 5 minutes at around 180 degrees C ) 
it takes around 5-8 minutes depending on the size of the chicken pieces
Pro Tip: if you want v juicy chicken, cut the chicken into larger pieces this will ensure a lovely brown coating without drying out the chicken as it will take longer to cook

For the coating: 
Combine all the ingredients together as mentioned in the caption and stir on heat for a minute
Add the slurry give it a few seconds to thicken 
Then turn off the heat and toss chicken in it evenly 

to serve: 
Serve with some more spring onions and sesame seeds
enjoy as is or on a bed of sticky rice
